title: The home_business model rewords a decision brief only through the citation check, and answers business questions through guarded tools
request: Plan H11: 'a decision brief written by a template, which a model may reword with every number cited'; the tools compare_periods and decision_brief; the home_business purpose with its data-limit test. The owner's standing rule: a new model purpose keeps its thinking for training, shown by a test.
spec: home_business sees only the template brief (totals, the change per group, at most 8 group names); its sentences are kept only when every one passes cited.py against the template (all or nothing), the code's caveat always added; compare_periods lets the model name the periods, the number and the grouping when the rules cannot, checked like the rules' reading; decision_brief says the last brief again. The model gets whether it answered, never a number.
plan: reword in business.py; the purpose, its data-limit and thinking tests.
give_brief shared by the rules and the tools; the two tools and their guard.
The Home prompt says when to use them.

decisions.decision: All or nothing: one dropped sentence keeps the template.
decisions.why: A dropped sentence may be the one that carried the point; a half-reworded brief could read as a different answer.

decisions.decision: The caveat ('association, not cause') is appended by code, never left to the model.
decisions.why: The one sentence that must always be there is not the model's to keep or drop.

decisions.decision: home_business may see at most 8 group names.
decisions.why: Group names are cell values of the person's table; the brief needs them, and no more.

change: dclab_rnd/draft/business.py (reword); draft/chat.py (give_brief; business_client; compare_periods, decision_brief and their guard); draft/work.py; models/settings.py (home_business); agents/harness.py; store/sets/llm.py (its stage); prompts/home_business.md (new), prompts/home_agent.md; tests.

findings.defect: The model's period labels reached the person.
findings.scenario: compare_periods took a_label and b_label, shown in the brief: a way for the model to write its own text or numbers into it.
findings.cause: The labels were the model's arguments.
findings.fix: Labels are written by code from the dates; the arguments are gone.

findings.defect: Cause and advice passed the check above the 'not cause' caveat.
findings.scenario: 'Revenue fell by 99.8 because beauty customers left [CHANGE]', 'home drove the fall', 'You should cut spending on home', Persian 'به دلیل … باید' were kept.
findings.fix: A reworded sentence with a cause, a reason or advice (English and Persian) keeps the template.

findings.defect: A number could be moved to another group or given the wrong direction.
findings.scenario: 'Revenue rose by 99.8' for a fall; 'electronics fell by 2,910.46', beauty's number.
findings.cause: cited.py checks a number is somewhere in the source, unsigned.
findings.fix: Each sentence's numbers must sit on its own group's line (the total's when it names none), its direction word matching that group's sign; one group per sentence.

findings.defect: A one-sentence rewording replaced the whole brief and its warnings.
findings.scenario: 'Revenue fell by 99.8 [CHANGE].' alone: the drivers, the scope, the rows left out and the coverage note were gone.
findings.cause: Any passing text replaced the template.
findings.fix: Every driver the template names must be in the rewording; the scope and the notes are the code's, always added; at most six sentences.

findings.scenario: by='amount' was answered, its values becoming group names.
findings.cause: A given 'by' skipped the rules' filter.
findings.fix: A given 'by' must be one of the columns the rules may split by.

measurements.name: The rewording and the tools, scripted
measurements.gate: a cited rewording used; an invented number never; the model's tool answers without a number; its thinking stored
measurements.result: A sentence with the change as the template writes it and [CHANGE] was used with the caveat added; an invented 12,345.67 kept the template; compare_periods answered with {answered, by} only; home_business's exchange kept its thinking text
limits: scripted model; a live run is owed

outcome: A business person can get the brief in plainer words from the model, with every number still the comparison's and the caveat always the code's; the model can answer a business question the rules could not read, without ever seeing a number.
lessons: Let the model write the words, and let code own the sentence that must never be dropped.
A citation check proves a number exists in the source, not that it belongs to what the sentence says: check the subject and the direction too.
risks: Not yet run live with Claude.
